Label and all 16 sentences written by the Sonnet 5.5 labeller from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + the edge hint) and one probe round of 8 sentences (none reused). An Opus gate checked rule-level items only and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Probe: 'slim', 'small' and the 'major' piece fired (0.4-0.6), while generic voting talk stayed under 0.05 and a bare 'the' scored only 0.11. So it is a next-token prediction of majority/minority, not voting in general; fire items put the context right before the word.
